manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} each odd-numbered turn, with {1}{U}{B} each even-numbered turn
notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying {8}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Move to your second extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

uses.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
